deltas.delta: Feature reuse is no longer only conceptual: current Transformers exposes Qwen image features before language decoding and current libmtmd exposes the encoded media embedding buffer.
Changed candidate ordering from raw-Qwen-vs-dedicated-backbone to merged-feature MVC first, tiny projection second, pre-merger instrumentation third, duplicate encoder last.
Official Qwen3-VL-Embedding design strengthens the case that raw generative visual features require explicit calibration/testing; no raw-feature retrieval/open-set claim is promoted.

Introduced VisualEncoderCompatibilityID binding prototypes to weights plus runtime/preprocessor/backend/token/canonicalization geometry, because current runtime evidence shows multimodal behavior can change with deployment parameters.

Added differential visual feature/behavior matrix across full-decode, dedicated encoder, merged reuse, tiny projection and optional dual-view same-encode path, with open-set, routing, recovery and resource metrics.
No target runtime benchmark was executed; no F-V01-06 subcheck is marked PASS; no final architecture promotion is claimed.
